items.name: CM50008
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM50006
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

The one-touch automatic coffee center has four programmable buttons that allow you to personalize your coffee size, strength and temperature; use the a la carte button to override the presets.Includes a separate coffee funnel for ground coffee and a hot-water dispenser with three temperature settings. Make up to two cups of coffee at a time without moving the cups. Just place your cup on the warming platform and milk is frothed directly into it.Height-adjustable spout accommodates large cups. Two stainless steel ThermoBlock heating systems are always ready, so there is no downtime. Coffee is prepared in seconds, while a graphic LED display indicates coffee's brewing progress.Easy-to-clean automated cleaning programs and Clearyl water-care system make decalcifying virtually obsolete. Made in Switzerland.

items.name: sku622852
items.description: Gaggia Swing Espresso Machine, Silver and Black
items.longDescription: Get your espresso faster. The 1300-watt stainless steel boiler uses Rapid Steam technology when switching between brewing and steaming. It features an LCD digital display, which provides alerts and programming options for the menu language, water hardness, acoustic alerts, water filter replacement, rinsing cycle and a whole lot more. Fifteen-bar pump pressure ensures perfectly extracted espresso, and ceramic burr grinder with adjustable settings lets you customize your grind. Gaggia Milk Island uses steam from the boiler to make automatic cappuccinos and lattes. The 57-oz. water reservoir is removable for easy refill. Made in Italy.

items.name: sku610212
items.description: Nescafe Dolce Gusto by Krups Chococino Capsules
items.longDescription: Delicious coffee is easy to prepare and ready in just seconds with these capsules. Pre-measured capsules effortlessly slide into your Krups Nescafe Dolce Gusto system to make a delectable espresso, caffe lungo, cappuccino, latte macchiato or chococino. The capsules deliver an even distribution of water and pressure over the coffee to ensure maximum flavor at up to 15 bars of pressure, giving you a cup of coffee in under a minute. Choose from five flavor varieties. Espresso and caffe lungo require one capsule per beverage of roast and ground Arabica coffee. Cappuccino and latte macchiato require two capsules per beverage: one of Arabica coffee, the other of whole milk and sugar. Chococino uses a capsule for hot chocolate and another for whole milk and sugar.

items.name: sku514174
items.longDescription: The internationally renowned Finum filters are the world?s most requested disposable tea filters. They give each tea enthusiast the chance to enjoy their tea in their individually preferred manner. Each size, Extra Slim and Large, has an especially long fill-in-flap, which makes it easier to fill in your tea. The flap is also used to fix the filter at the rim of your teapot by closing the lid. Tea filters are bleached true flavor filters made of all-natural substances. Includes 100 tea filters per box. Made in Germany. Extra Slim size makes up to two cups. Large size makes up to six cups.

items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM50007
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM50009
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.longDescription: Designed to offer maximum value, the Sun Crypto Accelerator 6000 PCIe adapter enables the efficient delivery of cost-effective network security to Oracle platforms running Oracle's Solaris operating system.Applications using the SSL protocol can increase transaction protection and performance from the Oracle crypto board. Capable of establishing SSL sessions at up to 13,000 RSA operations per second with 1,024-bit keys and more than 1 Gbps bulk encryption, the Sun Crypto Accelerator 6000 PCIe adapter efficiently offloads SSL functions and bulk encryption for any application - including IPSec from host processors.The Sun Crypto Accelerator 6000 PCIe adapter is FIPS 140-2 Level 3 qualified, which means the hardware is tamper protected and tamper evident, and that security parameters never leave the card unencrypted. The motion sensor is very easily set up and can be set to switch off after sensing no movement in time increments from 30 seconds to 1 hour. This frame is perfect for everyone from professionals to parents and grandparents who just want a frame that works with the convenience of not having to actually operate it. As well as its ease of use; the frame features a hi-res SVGA screen with LED back lighting. Importantly the frame will also play your MPEG-4 / .AVI video, JPEG photos. items.name: CM50003
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.longDescription: Delicious coffee is easy to prepare and ready in just seconds with these capsules. Pre-measured capsules effortlessly slide into your Krups Nescafe Dolce Gusto system to make a delectable espresso, caffe lungo, cappuccino, latte macchiato or chococino. The capsules deliver an even distribution of water and pressure over the coffee to ensure maximum flavor at up to 15 bars of pressure, giving you a cup of coffee in under a minute. Choose from five flavor varieties. Espresso and caffe lungo require one capsule per beverage of roast and ground Arabica coffee. Cappuccino and latte macchiato require two capsules per beverage: one of Arabica coffee, the other of whole milk and sugar. Chococino uses a capsule for hot chocolate and another for whole milk and sugar.

items.name: CM50002
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.longDescription:
SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.

Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation 

SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.

The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.

The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.

Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.

The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM550017
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: sku514117
items.longDescription: Trust Finum to take care of all your tea needs. Their patented Finum Bistro System offers you a very individual way to enjoy your tea. While gently steeping your tea, the hat prevents heat loss and retains the aroma. When the brewing is done, the hat serves as a handy drip-off tray for the brewing basket. Finum brewing baskets allow you to brew tea, herbal tea, fruit infusions or coffee. Both sizes offer ample room for the tea leaves to expand. Stainless steel mesh and heat-resistant plastic frame. Medium fits mugs and teapots with diameters from 65 - 95 mm. Large fits diameters from 70 - 100 mm. Dishwasher safe. Made in Germany.

items.name: sku140780
items.longDescription: Experience the same exquisite Italian espresso and cappuccino that is served in the world's finest restaurants. Illy uses a blend of the finest 100% Arabica beans meticulously selected from around the world. These coffees offer distinctive taste and exceptional freshness. 8.8-ounce can.

items.name: sku284299
items.longDescription: Perfect cappuccino is easy with this ingenious frother. You can heat milk, produce froth and serve in the 18/10 stainless steel pot. Useful with hot or cold milk, the frother can also be used for preparing other coffee drinks, whipping milk shakes or beating egg whites. It incorporates a heat-proof knob and Bakelite handles. Holds enough milk for 6 cups of cappuccino. Dishwasher safe.

items.name: 591149bl
items.longDescription: Featuring their signature retro styling that jazzes up any kitchen, FrancisFrancis!'s X8 Hyper Espresso System has an innovative 2-phase extraction that creates a smooth, full-bodied and intensely aromatic cup of espresso. It also creates thick, rich crema with 70% more volume and 20% more height than a traditional espresso. Patented pre-measured and tamped capsules ensure easy, consistent brewing results with every cup. Programmable auto-dosing of espresso volume allows you to customize coffee extraction. Features 15-bar pump, steamer arm for frothing milk and automatic capsule ejector. Made in Italy.Introductory price $499.95.

items.name: sku264648
items.longDescription: Clever design fuses Staub's signature colors with unique Japanese styling. Teapots include innovative details such as stainless steel handles that hold lids in place. Enameled cast iron heats evenly and quickly. Hand wash. Made in France. Lifetime warranty. 6 1/4" diam. 1 qt.

items.name: sku562686
items.longDescription: Pre-measured coffee pods deliver the perfect amount of coffee for your Keurig Brewing System. Weaved together with exotic and delicious coffee attributes. Taste winey berry tones from East Africa; deep, full-bodied Indonesian; and zesty and bright flavors from the Americas. Includes 18 K-Cups.

items.name: sku589713
items.description: illy iperEspresso Capsules, Dark Roast, 21 servings
items.longDescription: Effortlessly make a delicious, authentic Italian espresso from pre-measured, single-serving Arabica coffee capsules. The two-phase extraction results in a rich, smooth espresso with velvety, long-lasting crema. Capsules keep coffee from touching your machine, so there?s no coffee oil buildup. Choose from four flavors: dark roast, medium roast, decaffeinated or lungo. For use exclusively with Francis Francis X7 for illy iperEspresso Capsule Machines.

items.name: sku139089
items.longDescription: A wonderful gift for a new household, this dent-resistant, brushed stainless steel carafe is vacuum insulated to keep beverages hot or cold. Its lever action stopper allows for one-handed serving and its wide mouth can easily be filled with ice cubes. Dishwasher safe. Holds 1 2/3 quarts.

items.name: CM50014
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM50004
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM50001
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.longDescription: Find it first at Spaces. Rich crema espresso at the push of a button - perfectly fresh every time. Inspired by city skylines, ultra-slim and versatile new no-mess, capsule-based machine saves space on the countertop and create amazing coffee in seconds. At just five inches wide, Citiz brings the performance of much larger machines to compact kitchens. Just pop in your favorite blend and push a button - patented Nespresso Coffee Capsule technology and 19 bars of pressure deliver fresh, aromatic crema espresso every time. Features folding beverage tray for short or tall cups, large, easy-grip, 34-ounce water reservoir, removable drip tray and energy-saving standby mode. Made in Switzerland. The Nespresso Capsule System With classic Gran Cru coffees, special editions, and more, the easiest way to make espresso is also the tastiest. Capsules seal in freshness and capture the character of each blend for perfect flavor and aroma in every cup. Also available from Spaces: Nespresso Citiz & Milk espresso machines in two colors. Take our new CitiZ espresso machines for a test drive and have free cappuccino on us.

items.name: sku645887
items.description: Krups Precision Coffee Maker with 10-Cup Thermal Carafe
items.longDescription: Ten-cup coffee maker with sleek stainless-steel housing and thermal carafe looks great on any counter. Features an easy-to-read-and-program control panel and LCD screen that's uniquely angled to face upward. Dual auto-on presets make it possible to wake up to the smell of freshly brewed coffee before work in the morning, as well as at a later time when sleeping in on the weekends. Ten-cup thermal carafe designed to keep coffee hot for hours comes with a stay-cool handle and drip-free spout for serving. Maker includes an aroma selection for brewing smaller batches, and an oversized showerhead for improved flavor extraction. A push-button, soft-open lid and auto-lift brew basket makes for easy cleaning. One-year limited warranty.
